title: WWII Soldier POV: Bastogne — Surrounded in the Snow
hook: You dig into frozen ground outside Bastogne. Then the fog starts moving with engines behind it.
shortDescription: Experience the defense of Bastogne from the first-person perspective of a fictional U.S. airborne infantry soldier during the Battle of the Bulge. Cinematic historical reenactment, not archival footage.
longDescription: Enter an immersive first-person historical reenactment of Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge in December 1944. This episode follows a fictional composite U.S. airborne infantry soldier through frozen foxholes, fog, shortages, artillery, the clearing weather, aerial resupply and the opening of a relief corridor. The episode deliberately ends with the wider battle still continuing. AI-generated cinematic reenactment, not real wartime footage.
